key.aliyastoolkit.swap_hotbar: Swap Hotbar with Last Inventory Row
gui.aliyastoolkit.toolkit.title: Aliya's Toolkit Settings
gui.aliyastoolkit.hotbar_swap.descriptio: Press the key to swap the hotbar with the last inventory row.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.exact_match.t: Automatic refill: when enabled, only items with identical data components (enchantments, name, ...) are refilled. Durability is ignored.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.chain_limit.t: Left click +1, right click -1; hold Shift for steps of 16
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.preset.name: Preset %s/%s
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.preset.summar: Up %s, Down %s, Left %s, Right %s · Length %s · Lock direction: %s
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.preset.add.to: Copy the current preset into a new one (max 16)
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.preset.delete: Delete the current preset (at least one must remain)
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.up.tool: Blocks to extend upwards in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.down.to: Blocks to extend downwards in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.left.to: Blocks to extend left in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.shape.right.t: Blocks to extend right in the cross-section (0-4): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.length.toolti: Layers to extend forward (1-8): left click +1, right click -1
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.lock_directio: ON: horizontally forward normally; while sneaking you can also go 45 degrees up/down. OFF: straight up/down is also possible normally, and all directions are available while sneaking.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.allow_other_b: ON: inside the massive-block shape, other breakable blocks are broken as well (unbreakable blocks and fluids are skipped). OFF: only blocks identical to the targeted block are broken.
gui.aliyastoolkit.settings.chain.preset_: Switch preset: hold %s and scroll; stops at both ends and never toggles chain mining.
message.aliyastoolkit.preset: Preset %s/%s · Up %s, Down %s, Left %s, Right %s · Length %s · Lock direction: %s
aliyastoolkit.configuration.title: Aliya's Toolkit Configs
